author: Inside Edition
description: Remington Weckbacher, 22 survived a catastrophic orphan well explosion that killed two others and left him with severe burns over most of his body. The disaster in Washington County, Ohio occurred last summer, and Weckbacher is still healing. But he has become an advocate for burn survivors on their recovery journey. He shared his saga with Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall.
title: Massive Well Explosion Burned Nearly 80 Percent of Worker's Body
